name: MidEuropa
decision_note: London-headquartered Central European buyout investor (EUR 50-300m tickets, EUR 6.8bn raised since inception); active in Czechia (2026 construction-software acquisition) but private equity, not VC.

investments.company: ÚRS / First information systems / Callida (construction software platform carved out of DEK Group)

evidence.quote: MidEuropa, a leading private equity investor with deep roots in Central Europe, today announced the acquisition of the Czech Republic’s leading construction software platform from DEK Group.
Our flexible offering means we can offer majority or minority funding for businesses in Central Europe and beyond, investing from €50m to €300m.
€6.8BN Funds raised and managed since inception
consumer, retail, health services and pharmacy, technology, media & communications, business services, financial services, transport and logistics

analyst_notes: Rebranded from Mid Europa Partners to MidEuropa. Capital EUR 6.8bn = funds raised and managed since inception (cumulative), undated about page, as_of = retrieval date. The Czech acquisition (announced 2026-07-27) was expected to close in H2 2026. Sector list is from the 2020 CVCA self-reported profile (class D). UK legal entity (Mid Europa Partners LLP) not looked up.
